scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: There were more people involved in Adrian's last evening than we knew.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Who watched him leave? Start with that.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The departure record appears to have been altered.

metadata.evidence_summary: Adrian's last evening involved more than Victor and Kellan.
